newsitem.title: USA: Sam Zell REIT to buy Wellsford - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Sam Zell REIT to buy Wellsford - WSJ.

text.p: Samuel Zell's Equity Residential Properties Trust plans to acquire Wellsford Residential Property Trust for about $620 million in stock and debt, the Wall Street Journal reported Friday.

Chicago-based Equity Residential is expected to announce today that it will offer Wellsford shareholders 0.625 of its shares for each Wellsford share, a premium of about 5 percent that will total $468 million of common stock, the paper said.
Holders of $158 million of preferred shares will get newly issued preferred Equity Residential shares. Additionally, Equity Residential will assume $332 million in Wellsford debt, the Journal said.

Wellsford shareholders will also get one common share of a new company, Wellsford Real Properties Inc, for each share. The new entity will be spun off as a public company with a net book value expected between $2.50 and $2.75 a share, the newspaper said.
The paper said terms of the deal could be adjusted and give the parties the right to end their pact if Equity Residential's shares fall below $37.
